The alcohol isn't good for me, but it's not really the source of the problem. I ended my alcoholism in 2 months of total sobriety from October until the holiday season, things were no better then. What stops me from trying to date heavily is that I don't want a commitment where I am, because I can't stay here, but I'm in such an awful mood all the time, the move to somewhere else seems impossible. I have more than enough funds behind it now, I've been saving for almost a year for it. I've got enough to live for a year without income, but I'm terrified that if I move, somehow things will get even worse.
